Subject: POC close: throughput & cost snapshot + 30s audio permission

Hi Sam / Nora —

Thanks again for running the POC with us — really appreciated the team’s openness while we tuned routing and batching. Quick recap of the outcomes we measured across the evaluation window (sampled 7–10 Nov):

- Throughput (requests/sec) improved ~3.4x compared to your previous endpoint baseline.
- Median tail latency (p95) dropped ~45% for 512-token requests.
- Estimated cost per 1K tokens reduced ~28% using the suggested batching + quantization profile.
- Production success rate (no-retry responses) increased from 88% to 98% after KV-cache warmup.

I attached the raw metrics sheet and a latency graph for your review (poc_metrics_sheet.xlsx, screenshot_latency_graph.png).

Would BrightCart be comfortable with a short customer-facing asset? Two asks: (1) permission to publish a one-paragraph blurb that cites the top-line metrics above, and (2) a 30-second audio clip (or a written 1–2 sentence quote) we can use in a short case highlight. We can anonymize specifics if you prefer — e.g., refer to “a large retail customer” instead of BrightCart.

If you’re open to a 30s clip, here are a few optional slots next week: Tue 17 Nov 10:00–10:20 PT, Wed 18 Nov 09:30–09:50 PT, or Thu 19 Nov 14:00–14:20 PT. We’ll keep it casual — we can send a suggested 30s script and a brief agenda for the call.

Please let me know any constraints (legal review, logos, anonymization) and whether you want to review the final asset before publishing. If it helps, Laura can draft a short blurb for you to edit.

Thanks — excited by these results and happy to make the asset as comfortable as you want.

—Sergio
